slides.title:
🛡️ Multi-tier Login & Role-based Permissions
🛡️ Email Authentication & Supreme User Auth
🛡️ Sha256 Encrypted Passwords
🛡️ Token-based API Security
🛡️ Encrypted Communication & Data Sanitization
🛡️Usage of RESTful API
slides.narration: On this slide, we delve into the multi-tier login and role-based permissions system. First, we have email authentication and supreme user authentication, ensuring only authorized users can access the system. Next, we use SHA256 encryption to secure passwords, adding another layer of security. Token-based API security further enhances this by using tokens to authenticate API requests. To ensure data integrity, we also use encrypted communication and data sanitization. Lastly, we employ RESTful API for streamlined data interaction, making the system more accessible and efficient. Together, these components form a robust security framework.
